_comment: Dependency compatibility manifest for the pf360 Nerfstudio backend. 'verified' stays false until a full reconstruction (video -> PLY -> PointForge) has passed with exactly these versions on a real machine; record the machine + date in 'verifiedOn' when that happens. Sources: nerfstudio 1.1.5 wheel metadata (Requires-Python >=3.8, torch >=1.13.1, gsplat ==1.4.0) and the Nerfstudio install docs (torch 2.1.2 + CUDA 11.8).

recommended.gsplat: gsplat==1.4.0 (pulled in by nerfstudio); replaced by the prebuilt +pt21cu118 wheel because the JIT build fails on Windows with CUDA 11.8
recommended.cudaToolkitForGsplatJit: CUDA Toolkit 11.8 + MSVC C++ build tools
recommended.colmap: COLMAP 3.11.x (3.11.1 verified). pf360 runs COLMAP itself with --SiftExtraction.*/--SiftMatching.* options and a fixed PINHOLE camera
recommended.verifiedOn: 2026-11-21, Windows 11, RTX 3060 12 GB, driver 617.42, Python 3.10.7, CUDA Toolkit 11.8, MSVC 14.38: torch 2.1.2+cu118, nerfstudio 1.1.5, gsplat 1.4.0+pt21cu118 (prebuilt wheel), setuptools 69.5.1, COLMAP 3.11.1 (conda-forge cuda_126), FFmpeg 9.0.2. Preview preset on a SYNTHETIC 2880x1440 30 s clip (scripts/pf360/make_synthetic_360.py): 240/240 views registered, 7000 its, 259,599 Gaussians, PLY validated and loaded Z-up in PointForge. Not yet run on real 360 footage.

masking._comment: OPTIONAL add-on installed by scripts/pf360/setup_masking.ps1 into the pf360 env. Model: semantic segmentation on ADE20K (150 classes incl. person, car, bus, truck, van, bicycle, minibike, animal, sky). Licence checked on the model card (MIT). Safetensors only: torch 2.1 must not unpickle .bin weights.

nerfstudioCliFacts._source: nerfstudio 1.1.5 source, re-checked at run time via --help
nerfstudioCliFacts.equirectCropOrder: top, bottom, left, right (fractions; top/bottom drop elevation rings, left/right narrow yaw)
nerfstudioCliFacts.exportLayout: binary_little_endian float: x y z, f_dc_0..2, f_rest_*, opacity(logit), scale_0..2(log), rot_0..3(w,x,y,z)
